values: During the effective period of this Moratorium, no official, officer, board, or agency of the Town of Eliot shall accept, process, approve, deny, or in any other way act upon any application or request for any type of permit or approval relating to the siting, permitting, construction, installation, expansion, or operation of a data center of any size anywhere within the Town of Eliot.
scope: Visual source transcription only. Derived classifications and acceptance of individual fields are separate review decisions.
